name: 61 - API - Submit Clinical Intake Answers - Corrected V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::BIGINT AS case_id,
        $3::TEXT AS mobile,
        $4::JSONB AS answers
),

case_context AS (
    SELECT
        intake.*,
        clinic.name AS clinic_name
    FROM clinical_intake_cases intake
    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON request.case_id = intake.id
       AND request.mobile = intake.contact_mobile
    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = intake.clinic_id
       AND clinic.name = request.clinic_name
    WHERE intake.status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed')
    LIMIT 1
),

provided_answers AS (
    SELECT
        element ->> 'question_code'
            AS question_code,

        element -> 'answer'
            AS answer_json,

        CASE
            WHEN JSONB_TYPEOF(
                element -> 'answer'
            ) = 'string'
                THEN element ->> 'answer'
            ELSE element -> 'answer' #>> '{}'
        END AS answer_text

    FROM request_data request
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(
        request.answers
    ) AS element
),

applicable_templates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (template.question_code)
        template.*
    FROM clinical_intake_question_templates template
    CROSS JOIN case_context intake
    WHERE template.active = TRUE
      AND (
            template.clinic_id IS NULL
            OR template.clinic_id = intake.clinic_id
          )
      AND LOWER(template.symptom_category) IN (
            'general',
            LOWER(intake.symptom_category)
          )
    ORDER BY
        template.question_code,
        CASE
            WHEN template.clinic_id = intake.clinic_id
                THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        template.id DESC
),

invalid_codes AS (
    SELECT answer.question_code
    FROM provided_answers answer
    LEFT JOIN applicable_templates template
        ON template.question_code =
           answer.question_code
    WHERE template.id IS NULL
),

validated_answers AS (
    SELECT
        template.id AS question_template_id,
        answer.question_code,
        answer.answer_text,
        answer.answer_json,
        template.answer_type,
        template.maps_to_case_field,
        template.risk_if_true,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(
                COALESCE(answer.answer_text, '')
            ) IN (
                'true',
                '1',
                'yes',
                'on',
                'بله',
                'بلی',
                'آره',
                'نعم'
            )
                THEN TRUE

            WHEN LOWER(
                COALESCE(answer.answer_text, '')
            ) IN (
                'false',
                '0',
                'no',
                'off',
                'خیر',
                'نه',
                'لا'
            )
                THEN FALSE

            ELSE NULL
        END AS boolean_value,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                answer.answer_text,
                ''
            ) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
                THEN answer.answer_text::NUMERIC
            ELSE NULL
        END AS numeric_value

    FROM provided_answers answer
    INNER JOIN applicable_templates template
        ON template.question_code =
           answer.question_code
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM invalid_codes
    )
),

inserted_answers AS (
    INSERT INTO clinical_intake_answers (
        case_id,
        question_template_id,
        question_code,
        answer_text,
        answer_json,
        answered_at
    )
    SELECT
        context.id,
        answer.question_template_id,
        answer.question_code,
        answer.answer_text,
        answer.answer_json,
        NOW()
    FROM case_context context
    CROSS JOIN validated_answers answer
    ON CONFLICT (
        case_id,
        question_code
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        question_template_id =
            EXCLUDED.question_template_id,
        answer_text =
            EXCLUDED.answer_text,
        answer_json =
            EXCLUDED.answer_json,
        answered_at =
            NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

answer_flags AS (
    SELECT
        BOOL_OR(
            answer.risk_if_true = 'urgent'
            AND answer.boolean_value = TRUE
        ) AS has_urgent_answer,

        BOOL_OR(
            answer.risk_if_true = 'high'
            AND answer.boolean_value = TRUE
        ) AS has_high_answer

    FROM validated_answers answer
),

calculated_case AS (
    SELECT
        context.*,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.answer_text
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'duration_text'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.duration_text
        ) AS calculated_duration_text,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.numeric_value::INTEGER
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'severity'
                  AND answer.numeric_value
                      BETWEEN 0 AND 10
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.severity
        ) AS calculated_severity,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'pregnancy_possible'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.pregnancy_possible
        ) AS calculated_pregnancy_possible,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'is_worsening'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.is_worsening
        ) AS calculated_is_worsening,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'difficulty_breathing'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.difficulty_breathing
        ) AS calculated_difficulty_breathing,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'chest_pain'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.chest_pain
        ) AS calculated_chest_pain,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'loss_of_consciousness'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.loss_of_consciousness
        ) AS calculated_loss_of_consciousness,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'seizure'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.seizure
        ) AS calculated_seizure,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'severe_bleeding'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.severe_bleeding
        ) AS calculated_severe_bleeding,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'possible_overdose'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.possible_overdose
        ) AS calculated_possible_overdose,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'pregnancy_emergency_concern'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.pregnancy_emergency_concern
        ) AS calculated_pregnancy_emergency_concern,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.boolean_value
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'self_harm_or_violence'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.self_harm_or_violence
        ) AS calculated_self_harm_or_violence,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.answer_text
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'chronic_conditions'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.chronic_conditions
        ) AS calculated_chronic_conditions,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT answer.answer_text
                FROM validated_answers answer
                WHERE answer.maps_to_case_field =
                      'current_medications'
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            context.current_medications
        ) AS calculated_current_medications,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT has_urgent_answer
                FROM answer_flags
            ),
            FALSE
        ) AS has_urgent_answer,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT has_high_answer
                FROM answer_flags
            ),
            FALSE
        ) AS has_high_answer

    FROM case_context context
),

risk_calculation AS (
    SELECT
        calculated.*,

        CASE
            WHEN calculated.has_urgent_answer = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_difficulty_breathing = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_chest_pain = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_loss_of_consciousness = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_seizure = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_severe_bleeding = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_possible_overdose = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_pregnancy_emergency_concern = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_self_harm_or_violence = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_severity = 10
                THEN 'urgent'

            WHEN calculated.has_high_answer = TRUE
              OR calculated.calculated_severity >= 8
              OR calculated.calculated_is_worsening = TRUE
                THEN 'high'

            WHEN calculated.calculated_severity >= 5
              OR calculated.calculated_pregnancy_possible = TRUE
                THEN 'medium'

            ELSE 'low'
        END AS calculated_risk_level

    FROM calculated_case calculated
),

remaining_templates AS (
    SELECT
        template.id,
        template.question_code,
        template.question_text_fa,
        template.question_text_en,
        template.answer_type,
        template.options_json,
        template.required,
        template.risk_if_true,
        template.sort_order

    FROM applicable_templates template
    CROSS JOIN risk_calculation intake

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM clinical_intake_answers answer
        WHERE answer.case_id = intake.id
          AND answer.question_code =
              template.question_code
    )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM validated_answers submitted
        WHERE submitted.question_code =
              template.question_code
      )

      AND CASE template.maps_to_case_field
            WHEN 'duration_text'
                THEN intake.calculated_duration_text IS NULL
            WHEN 'severity'
                THEN intake.calculated_severity IS NULL
            WHEN 'pregnancy_possible'
                THEN intake.calculated_pregnancy_possible IS NULL
            WHEN 'is_worsening'
                THEN intake.calculated_is_worsening IS NULL
            WHEN 'difficulty_breathing'
                THEN intake.calculated_difficulty_breathing IS NULL
            WHEN 'chest_pain'
                THEN intake.calculated_chest_pain IS NULL
            WHEN 'loss_of_consciousness'
                THEN intake.calculated_loss_of_consciousness IS NULL
            WHEN 'seizure'
                THEN intake.calculated_seizure IS NULL
            WHEN 'severe_bleeding'
                THEN intake.calculated_severe_bleeding IS NULL
            WHEN 'possible_overdose'
                THEN intake.calculated_possible_overdose IS NULL
            WHEN 'pregnancy_emergency_concern'
                THEN intake.calculated_pregnancy_emergency_concern IS NULL
            WHEN 'self_harm_or_violence'
                THEN intake.calculated_self_harm_or_violence IS NULL
            WHEN 'chronic_conditions'
                THEN intake.calculated_chronic_conditions IS NULL
            WHEN 'current_medications'
                THEN intake.calculated_current_medications IS NULL
            ELSE TRUE
          END
),

updated_case AS (
    UPDATE clinical_intake_cases intake
    SET
        duration_text =
            calculated.calculated_duration_text,

        severity =
            calculated.calculated_severity,

        pregnancy_possible =
            calculated.calculated_pregnancy_possible,

        is_worsening =
            calculated.calculated_is_worsening,

        difficulty_breathing =
            calculated.calculated_difficulty_breathing,

        chest_pain =
            calculated.calculated_chest_pain,

        loss_of_consciousness =
            calculated.calculated_loss_of_consciousness,

        seizure =
            calculated.calculated_seizure,

        severe_bleeding =
            calculated.calculated_severe_bleeding,

        possible_overdose =
            calculated.calculated_possible_overdose,

        pregnancy_emergency_concern =
            calculated.calculated_pregnancy_emergency_concern,

        self_harm_or_violence =
            calculated.calculated_self_harm_or_violence,

        chronic_conditions =
            calculated.calculated_chronic_conditions,

        current_medications =
            calculated.calculated_current_medications,

        risk_level =
            calculated.calculated_risk_level,

        recommended_route =
            CASE calculated.calculated_risk_level
                WHEN 'urgent'
                    THEN 'emergency_services'
                WHEN 'high'
                    THEN 'urgent_clinic'
                WHEN 'medium'
                    THEN 'doctor_review'
                ELSE 'routine_appointment'
            END,

        status =
            CASE
                WHEN calculated.calculated_risk_level
                     IN ('urgent', 'high')
                    THEN 'escalated'

                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM remaining_templates
                    WHERE required = TRUE
                )
                    THEN 'awaiting_patient'

                ELSE 'routed'
            END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM risk_calculation calculated

    WHERE intake.id = calculated.id

    RETURNING intake.*
),

upserted_handoff AS (
    INSERT INTO human_handoff_tasks (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        appointment_id,
        task_type,
        source_type,
        source_record_id,
        priority,
        status,
        reason,
        due_at
    )
    SELECT
        intake.clinic_id,
        intake.patient_id,
        intake.appointment_id,
        'clinical_triage',
        'clinical_intake',
        intake.id,

        CASE intake.risk_level
            WHEN 'urgent' THEN 'urgent'
            WHEN 'high' THEN 'high'
            ELSE 'normal'
        END,

        'open',

        CONCAT(
            'پاسخ‌های جدید در پرسش تخصصی اولیه ثبت شد. سطح ریسک: ',
            intake.risk_level,
            '. شرح بیمار: ',
            intake.chief_complaint
        ),

        CASE intake.risk_level
            WHEN 'urgent' THEN NOW()
            WHEN 'high' THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour'
            ELSE NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours'
        END

    FROM updated_case intake
    WHERE intake.risk_level IN ('urgent', 'high')

    ON CONFLICT (
        source_type,
        source_record_id,
        task_type
    )
    WHERE source_record_id IS NOT NULL

    DO UPDATE SET
        priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
        reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
        due_at = LEAST(
            COALESCE(
                human_handoff_tasks.due_at,
                EXCLUDED.due_at
            ),
            EXCLUDED.due_at
        ),
        status = CASE
            WHEN human_handoff_tasks.status = 'cancelled'
                THEN 'open'
            ELSE human_handoff_tasks.status
        END,
        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING *
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM invalid_codes
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_case
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN 'clinical_intake_case_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM invalid_codes
        )
            THEN 'invalid_question_codes'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'urgent_clinical_intake_updated'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'high'
        )
            THEN 'high_risk_clinical_intake_updated'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM remaining_templates
            WHERE required = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'clinical_intake_answers_saved_more_information_required'

        ELSE 'clinical_intake_answers_completed'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN 'پرونده مطابق کلینیک و شماره موبایل پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM invalid_codes
        )
            THEN 'یک یا چند کد سؤال برای این پرونده معتبر نیست.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'پاسخ‌ها ثبت شد. وضعیت نیازمند ارزیابی فوری است و نباید منتظر پاسخ خودکار ماند.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'high'
        )
            THEN 'پاسخ‌ها ثبت و پرونده برای بررسی سریع انسانی ارجاع شد.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM remaining_templates
            WHERE required = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'پاسخ‌ها ثبت شد و هنوز اطلاعات تکمیلی لازم است.'

        ELSE 'پاسخ‌های لازم ثبت شد و پرونده آماده مسیریابی است.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT JSONB_AGG(question_code)
        FROM invalid_codes
    ) AS invalid_question_codes,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS clinical_intake_case_id,

    (
        SELECT risk_level
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS risk_level,

    (
        SELECT recommended_route
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS recommended_route,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS case_status,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM upserted_handoff
    ) AS handoff_task_id,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'question_template_id',
                        id,
                    'question_code',
                        question_code,
                    'question_text',
                        question_text_fa,
                    'answer_type',
                        answer_type,
                    'options',
                        options_json,
                    'required',
                        required,
                    'risk_if_true',
                        risk_if_true
                )
                ORDER BY sort_order, id
            )
            FROM (
                SELECT *
                FROM remaining_templates
                ORDER BY
                    required DESC,
                    sort_order,
                    id
                LIMIT 8
            ) next_question_rows
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS next_questions,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'seek_immediate_local_emergency_help_and_human_review'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'high'
        )
            THEN 'human_review'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM remaining_templates
            WHERE required = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'collect_more_answers'

        ELSE 'route_clinical_intake'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## ثبت پاسخ‌ها و ارزیابی مجدد

ورودی `answers` یک آرایه است:

`[{"question_code":"severity","answer":6}]`

پاسخ‌ها Upsert می‌شوند؛ بنابراین بیمار می‌تواند پاسخ قبلی را اصلاح کند.

هر پاسخ پرریسک، مسیر پرونده را به ارجاع انسانی تغییر می‌دهد. این ارزیابی تشخیص پزشکی نیست.

اصلاح V2:
پاسخ‌های همین درخواست در next_questions دوباره نمایش داده نمی‌شوند.
